list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18; names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them; guides original to this atlas

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap: finish the story, work the 100% checklist, then mop up the stranger strands and any stragglers. Budget around 200 hours, most of it on A Long Road. Everything is single-player: no online or DLC trophies, no difficulty setting.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1 — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy arrives as Chapter 2 opens, with its first mission What's in the Bag?, so do not worry if it does not pop at the last Chapter 1 cutscene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. An automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Free roam carries on after the credits, so everything else can be cleaned up afterwards. No chapter number is pinned to it here: the two main guides place the finale in different chapters, so this atlas does not assert one.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy and the long grind, roughly 100 of the 200 platinum hours. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the credits, but everything done during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It has 35 requirements and most need only part of a set. The ones that need everything: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), all underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Partial credit: 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans. See the 100% Checklist tab for the full breakdown.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track the count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and the map can show every Stunt Spot. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, then Activities shows what is left. Most of these come naturally while playing.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 2 ranges: Griffin Shooting Range (18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch (24 golds). Buy a $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk inside each store to unlock the challenges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. The 100% checklist needs every gold too, so this is not a detour.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough here. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from, and winning the same race again does not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — the last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds. Cars in better condition pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18. There are 10 locations, and meditating at one with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, for 18 in total. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — call your partner so you can go together. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony at Jason's house and accept it — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. There are 18 sets holding 480 cards in total; the Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel — the 100% checklist needs 100 too.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, then Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so keep going.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle/Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, then Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — checked 20 November 2026. The description says: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. What that means in play — which bar, which prompt — has not been confirmed by any guide we cite. Do not trust a method that cites no source; check the PowerPyx and GTABase guides again, they will update as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — checked 20 November 2026. The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom; that is a reading of the description, not a tested method. No guide we cite has confirmed the exact steps.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, then Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, then Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — checked 20 November 2026. 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt; that is a guess at the wording, not a method. PowerPyx notes an unconfirmed guess linking it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — treat that as speculation, not a guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — checked 20 November 2026. The description ('What the hell just happened?') points at a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. PowerPyx notes an unconfirmed guess about a UFO questline — treat that as speculation, not a guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — checked 20 November 2026. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by); that is a reading of the description, not a tested method. PowerPyx notes an unconfirmed guess about kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — treat that as speculation.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 spent across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
